title: BioFailureBench Scientific Failure Trap Schema (BNS-014 / BNS-011)
description: Schema definition for community-submitted scientific failure traps in BioFailureBench.

prompt.description: The user query / analytical request containing the hidden scientific flaw.

expected_status.description: Authoritative routing / fail-closed verdict expected from BioNexus.

expected_capability.description: The target capability ID (e.g. scrna.pseudobulk_de, spatial.morans_svg, variant.acmg_classification).

data_metadata.description: Input data context metadata (replicates, coordinate variance, normalization state, etc.).

expected_violations.description: Substrings expected in the decision violation list.

required_remedies.description: Substrings expected in the actionable scientific remedies.

allowed_computation.description: Exact description of what computation remains scientifically legal under this flaw.

forbidden_claim.description: The scientific claim that is explicitly blocked and forbidden.

failure_mode.description: The failure mode ID in Failure Taxonomy v1 (BN-F001..BN-F012, or NONE for positive controls).

reference.description: Peer-reviewed literature citation or standard operating procedure justifying the ground truth.

description.description: Description of the trap prefixed with 'TRAP:' (or 'CONTROL:' for positive controls, 'FRONTIER TRAP:' for known limitations).

known_limitation.description: Set to true if this trap represents a known frontier limitation that is not yet deterministic.
